title: Trading Day: AI disruption, US-Iran nuclear talks, rate cut bets keep investors on their toes
description: Wall Street stocks see-sawed to nominal gains on Tuesday as investors juggled ongoing concerns over spending on artificial intelligence and the potential economic disruptions AI may bring, with positive signals from Iran regarding the progress of nuclear talks with the United States.

title: Hope Iran is going to be more reasonable: Trump ahead of Nuclear talks
description: WASHINGTON, Feb 17: US President Donald Trump on Monday said he would be involved “indirectly” in high-level nuclear negotiations between the United States and Iran, set for Tuesday in Geneva. title: 'Progress made, Iran to come back in two weeks with detailed proposals': US official on nuclear talks
description: Iran would return in the next two weeks with detailed proposals to address the gaps, a United States official said following high-stakes nuclear negotiations between Washington and Tehran.

title: Vance Says US 'Red Lines' Unmet After Latest Iran Talks
description: Iran said Tuesday it had agreed with the United States in talks in Geneva on guiding principles for a deal to avoid conflict, but Vice President JD Vance said Tehran had not yet acknowledged all of Washington's red lines.

title: Explained: Why Iran’s Strait of Hormuz move is a big deal
description: Iran conducted live-fire military drills in the Strait of Hormuz and temporarily restricted traffic, raising fresh concerns about global oil supplies as tensions with the United States intensify.

title: 'Weapon capable of sinking warship more dangerous'
description: Iran's supreme leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei declared that US President Donald Trump's efforts to dismantle the Islamic republic would fail. These remarks came as Iran and the United States commenced a second round of talks in Geneva. Khamenei also issued a warning regarding a US warship deployed in the Gulf.
